proposals.name: Track Order
proposals.description: When the customer is asking for assistance or information on how to track their order.
proposals.rationale: This intent is distinct as it specifically addresses a common customer inquiry about tracking orders, which is not explicitly covered by existing intents. It captures a specific action that customers frequently need assistance with, separate from general order status inquiries.

proposals.name: Product Usage and Special Features
proposals.description: When the customer asks about how to use a specific product in their daily routine or inquires about the special features of that product.
proposals.rationale: This intent captures a distinct pattern where customers are not only interested in the product itself but also in practical usage and unique benefits, which is not fully covered by existing intents. It combines elements of usage instructions and product specialty inquiries, providing a more focused response to customers seeking detailed guidance on specific products.
